title.narrative: An Inclusive Approach for Harnessing Marine Ecosystem Services and Transforming to Sustainable Blue Economy in the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden (HESBERSGA)

description.narrative: Improve the coordinated management of the Red Sea and Gulf of Adenâ€™s marine and coastal areas in support of a Sustainable Blue Economy in the region.
Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.

Yes.The objectives of the project, which aim at accelerating transition of ocean economies in the RSGA region into a successful SBE will help restore, protect and maintain the diversity, productivity and resilience of marine and coastal ecosystems, and contribute to increased resilience and improved livelihoods of coastal communities. As indicated in the target under GEF Core Indicator 11, the project is expected to benefit directly or indirectly 80,000 people, of which at least 30% will be women (which reflect the realities in the region), through development of innovative financial instruments and incentives to stimulate investments in SBE projects (Component 3), but also through improvement of health of coastal and marine ecosystems (Component 2), which will contribute to their improved capacity to deliver ecosystem goods and services in support of the SBE. Some other key socio-economic benefits that will be generated by the project include: an enabling environment through enhanced capacity of key institutions providing support to local communities dependent on coastal and marine resources; stronger focus on gender equity that will contribute to them becoming an increasingly important factor in SBE; and increased use of area-based conservation and planning measures, such as MPA and MSP, which will enhance SBE opportunities by creating a more stable environment for investments, in particular by the private sector.
